name: workely-open-data
title: Workely open data: Price Index and Open Ledger
description: Two separate series, never blended. (1) Workely Price Index: advertised prices from businesses' own public pages, cells published at 30 or more distinct businesses. (2) TWC Open Ledger: binned residential numbers from The Total Wash Co. in Madison, WI.

resources.name: price-index-cells
resources.title: Workely Price Index: published cells
resources.description: Advertised prices read from businesses' own public price pages. One row per cell and unit with at least 30 distinct businesses. Aggregates only; no business is named or identifiable.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: What the price is for, for example per_clean, per_house_wash, per_driveway.

fields.name: n_businesses
fields.description: Distinct businesses behind the row. Never below 30.

fields.name: p25
fields.description: 25th percentile advertised price, in the currency column.

fields.name: share_from_price
fields.description: Share of businesses whose price is a starting "from" price, 0 to 1.

resources.name: ledger-t1-leads-by-channel-quarter
resources.title: TWC Open Ledger: leads by channel quarter
resources.description: Residential numbers from The Total Wash Co., Madison, WI. Equals the matching table in data/ledger/data.json, which is a copy of https://www.workely.ai/research/lead-ledger/data.json.

fields.name: row_n
fields.description: Row total: the sum of the published cells only, so hidden cells cannot be recovered by subtraction.

fields.name: leads
fields.description: Residential leads, count, or the word "suppressed" when the cell is under 10.

resources.name: ledger-t2-lead-to-quote-rate-by-channel
resources.title: TWC Open Ledger: lead to quote rate by channel
resources.description: Residential numbers from The Total Wash Co., Madison, WI. Equals the matching table in data/ledger/data.json, which is a copy of https://www.workely.ai/research/lead-ledger/data.json.

fields.name: with_quote
fields.description: Leads with a recorded sent quote, or "suppressed".

fields.name: rate_pct
fields.description: Percent with a recorded quote, "suppressed", or a "withheld: ..." note.

resources.name: ledger-t3-quote-outcomes
resources.title: TWC Open Ledger: quote outcomes
resources.description: Residential numbers from The Total Wash Co., Madison, WI. Equals the matching table in data/ledger/data.json, which is a copy of https://www.workely.ai/research/lead-ledger/data.json.

fields.name: booked
fields.description: Quotes linked to a real job within 120 days.

fields.name: booked_rate_pct
fields.description: Booked share of closed quotes, percent.

resources.name: ledger-t5-price-bands-by-service
resources.title: TWC Open Ledger: price bands by service
resources.description: Residential numbers from The Total Wash Co., Madison, WI. Equals the matching table in data/ledger/data.json, which is a copy of https://www.workely.ai/research/lead-ledger/data.json.

fields.name: p25
fields.description: 25th percentile job total, USD, rounded to $5, or "suppressed".

fields.name: median
fields.description: Median job total, USD, rounded to $5, or "suppressed".

fields.name: p75
fields.description: 75th percentile job total, USD, rounded to $5, or "suppressed".

resources.name: ledger-t6-booked-rate-by-quote-total-band
resources.title: TWC Open Ledger: booked rate by quote total band
resources.description: Residential numbers from The Total Wash Co., Madison, WI. Equals the matching table in data/ledger/data.json, which is a copy of https://www.workely.ai/research/lead-ledger/data.json.

fields.name: n_closed
fields.description: Closed residential sent quotes, all time.

resources.name: ledger-t9-median-ticket-by-quarter
resources.title: TWC Open Ledger: median ticket by quarter
resources.description: Residential numbers from The Total Wash Co., Madison, WI. Equals the matching table in data/ledger/data.json, which is a copy of https://www.workely.ai/research/lead-ledger/data.json.

fields.name: median
fields.description: Median job total, USD, rounded to $5.
